card.name: Warning signs before sudden sleep episodes
card.fires_on: The word "warning" (or the "signs" after it) in sentences saying patients on dopaminergic drugs fell asleep suddenly with no warning signs of drowsiness.

modes.label: Warning in sleep-attack text
modes.description: "warning" or the following "signs" after a negation like no, any or without, in the sudden-onset-of-sleep passage.
modes.example: some did not perceive<< warning>> signs, such as excessive drowsiness

modes.label: Rare other spots
modes.description: Occasional firing inside words later in the same passage or in unrelated text.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning warning, alert or notice, so the text continues about advance warnings.
card.plain: It fires on the phrase about having no warning signs before suddenly falling asleep on Parkinson's-type drugs.
